articles.text_snippet: BT is launching a nationwide programme, Cyber Prepared UK, designed to increase the nation's resilience by transforming the way Britain's small businesses respond to growing cyber-attacks. It comes as new BT data shows that AI has helped drive a more than 500% increase in malicious cyber scans – where criminals probe businesses for weaknesses in their defences – over the last year.
articles.title: BT launches nationwide cyber resilience drive as AI helps fuel 500% surge in malicious activity
